allowances.justification: The audited memory boundary allocates bounded caller-sized graph columns and result slices; every caller retains the allocator and has matching error rollback and deinit coverage.
The audited memory boundary copies bounded source metadata into graph-owned storage; every returned slice is released by the owning graph result or temporary resolver scope.
